title: I −23 ±0.5 · TP ≤ −1
summary: An editable −23 LUFS monitoring profile with a ±0.5 LU band and −1 dBTP ceiling.
descriptionMarkdown: A compact starting point for monitoring integrated loudness around −23 LUFS and true peak at or below −1 dBTP. This is an editable monitoring rule set, not a certified delivery standard; review and adapt it for the requirements that apply to your work.
